method_note: The 2026 edition (Cologne, 3-6 Nov 2026, joint with iSpaRo) has not yet taken place, so the most recent completed edition, i-SAIRAS 2024 (Brisbane, 19-22 Nov 2024), was analysed. Counted 42 parallel technical sessions (session codes S2-S12, rooms P1-P4 and PA) from the official online technical program. Excluded: opening/plenary sessions 1, 5 and 9, the closing ceremony, and three Expert Panels (Terrestrial Mining & Space; Space Engagement Opportunities; Trust and AI). Paper counts per session were not extracted (null). Mapping uses session titles only (no paper titles checked), so mixed sessions such as 'Spacecraft 2/4', 'Technology Transfer 2/3' and 'Visualisation and Simulation' carry more uncertainty. Keywords below 0.02 (manipulation, osam, earth-obs, autonomy, slam, motion-planning; together 0.071 of session-units) were dropped and the remaining weights renormalized to sum to 1.
